_template_comment: DEPLOYMENT TEMPLATE — DO NOT USE VERBATIM IN PRODUCTION. REPLACE-WITH-... placeholders must be replaced with real values. CLAUDE_MATTER_MODE is set to warn for observation; set to enforce for production. failIfUnavailable is false for environments without sandbox support; set to true for production. See docs/production-architecture.md for deployment guidance.
_telemetry_note: Telemetry routes to the firm OTLP collector. Content (prompts/responses) is NOT captured — only metadata: that a session occurred, tool counts, token counts. Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to your collector endpoint.
claudeMd:
REPLACE-WITH-YOUR-FIRM-NAME policy for all Claude Code use.

Scope. Confine each session to one matter. Start the session in that matter's folder, not in a parent folder, a drive root or your home directory. Do not extend the working directory to reach another client's material.

Material you must not enter without the principal's prior written approval, recorded on the matter file: anything subject to an order as to confidentiality, suppression or non-publication; anything obtained from another party or a third person under compulsion in a proceeding, which is subject to the implied Harman undertaking not to use it for a purpose extraneous to that proceeding; material produced on subpoena or under a notice to produce; anything subject to a statutory prohibition or restriction on publication or disclosure, including in proceedings concerning children; privileged information, including privilege belonging to a person other than the client; and information confidential or private to a person other than the client where that person's consent has not been obtained. Before any such approval is given the responsible practitioner must be satisfied that the information will remain within the controlled environment of the platform, that the supplier is bound by confidentiality restrictions so the data is neither made publicly available nor used to train any large language model, that it is used only in connection with that proceeding, and that it is not used to train the program or any model. A retention period is not publication and is not training, so the absence of a zero retention arrangement does not by itself prevent approval. Where no such arrangement is available, satisfaction rests instead on the contractual term that inputs and outputs are not used to train any model and are not made publicly available, on the closure of every channel that retains material for longer than the ordinary session, and on the practitioner being able to show from the practice's own records that the material was sent, when, by whom and to which endpoint. Being told a tool is closed, ringfenced or confidential is not itself sufficient assurance, and the obligation is capable of being breached where outputs are later used for a different purpose. Where you cannot be satisfied of each matter, the material is not to be used with any tool, and difficulty in establishing them is a reason not to proceed rather than a reason to proceed.

Evidence. Do not generate the content of an affidavit, a witness statement or a character reference. Do not alter, embellish, strengthen, dilute or otherwise rephrase a witness's evidence. Do not draft or prepare any part of an expert report. Preparatory work is permitted.

Verification. Verify every citation, authority and legislative reference against the primary source before it is relied on. Verification must not be carried out solely by AI. Use of AI does not qualify or absolve any professional or ethical obligation to the court.

Records. Session transcripts are firm records. Do not copy them outside the firm's systems and do not use the feedback, bug or share commands. Telemetry to the firm's collector records that a session occurred and how much was sent, not what was sent: prompt and response content is redacted unless the content gates are set, and they are deliberately left unset. The record of what a tool produced, and of how it was verified, is made on the matter file.
_failIfUnavailable_note: SET TO true IN PRODUCTION. false here only for observation period deployments where sandbox may be unavailable.
